definition: [ קוֺנֵן ] verb denominative Po`l. chant a קִינָה ; — Perfect 3 plural consecutive וְקוֺנְנוּ Ezek 27:32 ( עַל person), suffix (cognate) וְקוֺנְוּהָ Ezek 32:16 Imperfect 3 masculine singular וַיְקֹנֵן 2Sam 1:17 (with accusative of congnate meaning with verb + עַל person), compare ( עַל person only), 2Chr 35:25 and ( אֶל person) 2Sam 3:33 3 feminine plural תְּקוֺנֶנָּה with accusative of congnate meaning with verb, Ezek 32:16 , + עַל person v Ezek 32:16 Participle as substantive Jer 9:16 (professional) wailing women.
